name: Bar Chart
description: Categorical comparison chart container with accessible explanatory content.
useWhen: Users need to compare a small set of categorical values at a glance.
avoidWhen: Exact tabular comparison is more important than visual magnitude, or the data is primarily time-series.

accessibility.notes: Keep category names and numeric values visible in text so the comparison does not rely on bar length or color alone.
keyboard: The baseline chart is read-only; interactive drill-down actions must be keyboard reachable when added.
aria: Expose each category and value as readable text and preserve the chart title as its accessible context.
